sloka: अमात्यान् अब्रवीत् राजा हर्ष पर्याकुल लोचन ।संभाराः संभ्रियंताम् मे गुरूणाम् वचनात् इह ॥१-८-१४॥
transliteration: amātyān abravīt rājā harṣa paryākula locana ।saṁbhārāḥ saṁbhriyaṁtām me gurūṇām vacanāt iha ॥1-8-14॥

translations.english: "Let the articles required (for performing the sacrifice) be procured in accordance with the words of my spiritual preceptors and the horse be released under the protection of able men.
